history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration establish a process requiring partners to declare the availability of separate interest- bearing bank accounts when submitting project proposals in order to improve the reporting and reimbursement of interest income.
history.administration_response: This recommendation is linked to paragraph 461 of the Board’s 2023 audit report (A/79/5 (Vol. I)). The system check is still under development in the One Grant Management System. Due to multiple ongoing priorities and limited resources, this recommendation is expected to be implemented by the end of 2026.
history.board_assessment: Given that this recommendation is expected to be implemented by the end of 2026, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
